paragraphs.heading: Parties
paragraphs.text: This Agreement is made between Brackenfield Solar Limited (the "Generator") and Northwind Energy Supply Limited (the "Buyer").

paragraphs.heading: Schedule 1: Facility
paragraphs.text: Contracted Capacity: 49.9 MW (AC), measured at the Delivery Point.

paragraphs.heading: Schedule 1: Facility
paragraphs.text: The Facility means the solar photovoltaic generating station and co-located battery storage at Bracken Farm, Wickham.

paragraphs.heading: 1. Definitions
paragraphs.text: "Commercial Operation" means the date on which the Facility first exports electricity under this Agreement.

paragraphs.heading: 1. Definitions
paragraphs.text: "Delivery Point" means the Point of Connection to the distribution system at Wickham Primary Substation.

paragraphs.heading: 2. Term
paragraphs.text: This Agreement continues for 10 years from Commercial Operation.

paragraphs.heading: 3. Price
paragraphs.text: The Contract Price shall be £61.50 per MWh, indexed annually to the Consumer Prices Index.

paragraphs.heading: 4. Delivery
paragraphs.text: The Buyer shall purchase all electricity exported by the Facility at the Delivery Point.

paragraphs.heading: 5. Metering
paragraphs.text: Metering shall comply with the Balancing and Settlement Code.

paragraphs.heading: 6. Commercial Operation
paragraphs.text: The Generator shall use reasonable endeavours to achieve Commercial Operation on or before 31 March 2029 (the "Target COD").

paragraphs.heading: 6. Commercial Operation
paragraphs.text: If Commercial Operation has not occurred by 31 December 2029 (the "Long-Stop Date"), the Buyer may terminate this Agreement by notice to the Generator.

paragraphs.heading: Execution
paragraphs.text: Signed for and on behalf of Northwind Energy Supply Limited on 3 March 2025.

paragraphs.heading: Execution
paragraphs.text: Signed for and on behalf of Brackenfield Solar Limited on 3 March 2025.
